<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            b=n['boundary']; out['N']=(min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            b=n['boundary']; out['P']=(min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    return out
print('before', state(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT', state(current_frame), last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
# HUD check: count N icons in bottom bar
seg=current_frame.segmentation
hud=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])>=50]
print('HUD N px', [n['pixels'] for n in hud])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
